content.what_it_is: MATLAB plotting script that loads 12 numerical station files (lines 5-10), vertically offsets and plots numerical stations 2-12 as dashed curves (lines 14-19), loads an 11-column reference elevation file and constructs a fixed 0.01-second time axis starting at 20 seconds (lines 20-25), applies plot axes and labels (lines 26-29), then annotates the 11 curves with hard-coded water-depth strings (lines 30-44).
entities: fdir path prefix assigned at line 3
k loop variable defined at lines 5, 14, 22, and 42
num formatted filename suffix assigned at line 6
gage station matrix assigned at line 7
z vertically offset numerical-series matrix populated at line 8
time numerical time vector assigned from the final gage at line 10
mea reference-series matrix assigned at line 20
time_m reference time vector assigned at line 21
zm vertically offset reference curve assigned at line 23
txt 11-by-4 character label matrix populated at lines 30-40

equations.ref: centimetre conversion plus station-dependent vertical offset
reference time coordinate with 0.01-second spacing and 20-second origin
centimetre conversion plus reference-curve vertical offset

unresolved: Lines 7-10 overwrite gage on each load and then derive time only from the twelfth station, while lines 15-19 plot every z(:,2:12) column against that final station's time. Equal row counts do not guarantee equal timestamps, so differing station time coordinates are silently mispaired; unequal row counts instead fail during z assignment or plotting.
Line 8 assumes every station file has at least two columns and compatible row counts, and line 20 together with lines 22-24 assumes mketa.out has at least 11 columns; neither interface is validated.

The numerical curves use the final station's explicit time column at line 10, whereas reference time_m at line 21 is synthesized with hard-coded 0.01 spacing and a 20-second offset. The file performs no duration/length check before plotting lines 23-24.

The commented clf at line 12 leaves figure and hold state untouched. clear all at line 1 does not reset an existing axes hold state, so if hold was already on, the first plot at line 15 can overlay stale graphics rather than reset the axes.

Station 1 is loaded and stored at lines 5-10 but numerical plotting starts at k=2 on line 14, while the 11 reference columns are plotted as k=1:11 at line 22. This appears to establish a station-2-to-reference-column-1 mapping, but no explicit assertion or metadata verifies that interface.
